note: Single source of truth for SDK type generation and contract tests. Move only with controller approval; every move requires regenerating sdk/ts/src/types.gen.ts and sdk/python/src/edda_sdk/types_gen.py and committing both (CI fails on stale types). Release/publication waits independent acceptance. A PR which changes spec/ or tests/fixtures/events/ must move this pin in the same PR and commit the regenerated type files with it — a pin moved in a later PR leaves contract red on main in between (#934).
